stem: How did the authors define an orphan non-coding RNA locus when annotating across TCGA?
choices: Present in cancer samples and absent from any annotated small RNA family
Significantly present in cancer samples and absent in tumor-adjacent normal tissue
Expressed above a fixed counts-per-million threshold in any cancer sample
Present in cancer samples and absent from matched germline DNA
answer: Significantly present in cancer samples and absent in tumor-adjacent normal tissue
